title: Pharmaceutical Warehouse Optimization System
short: Improves slotting, picking routes and FEFO compliance in pharmaceutical warehouses, and plans delivery routes.
symptom: Picking is slow and FEFO is not always followed
ingredient: A layout and route optimizer for warehouses
directions: Connect warehouse stock, locations and order history. Get slotting suggestions, optimized pick paths and delivery route plans.
problem: Fast-moving items are often stored far from dispatch, pickers walk long routes, FEFO is broken under pressure, and delivery routes are planned manually.
why: Inefficient warehouses delay deliveries, increase picking errors and leave short-dated stock unsold.
solution: Analyzes order patterns to place fast movers near dispatch within storage-condition zones, generates pick paths that enforce FEFO, and optimizes delivery routes with time windows and cold-chain constraints.
limitations: Storage conditions and segregation rules (e.g. controlled drugs) always take priority
review: The warehouse manager approves layout changes; GDP requirements are never overridden.
